name: Minecraft: Dream it, Build it!
summary: Minecraft is Mojang's sandbox game for building, exploring and surviving in endless block worlds, alone or with friends. The latest Minecraft APK is version 1.26.60.4, updated October 21, 2026, and needs Android 8.0 or newer. It costs $6.99 on Google Play, with optional Marketplace purchases and no ads.
metaDescription: Get the official Minecraft APK 1.26.60 for Android 8.0+, $6.99 on Google Play. Survival vs Creative, cross-play with friends, Realms, and install steps.

faq.q: How do I install Minecraft on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for Minecraft and check the developer is Mojang before tapping the price button. It needs Android 8.0 or newer. It costs $6.99 on Google Play, and once bought it's tied to your Google account, so you can reinstall it on any phone for free. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from Mojang and may be altered, so the safest way to play Minecraft is the official listing.

faq.q: How much does Minecraft cost on Android?
faq.a: Minecraft costs $6.99 on Google Play in the US; prices vary by country. It's a one-time purchase, with optional in-app purchases from $0.99 to $49.99 per item for Marketplace content and Minecoins. There's also a free Minecraft Trial with limited play time.

faq.q: Can I play Minecraft on Android with friends on Xbox or PC?
faq.a: Yes. The Android version is Minecraft Bedrock Edition, which supports cross-play with Bedrock on Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, Windows and iPhone. Sign in with a free Microsoft account to join friends. It can't join Java Edition servers.

faq.q: Is Minecraft on Android the full game?
faq.a: Yes. The Google Play version is the full Bedrock Edition, with Survival, Creative and Adventure modes, the Nether, the End, multiplayer and the Marketplace. It was once called Pocket Edition, but now matches other Bedrock platforms.

Realms is Mojang's paid subscription for private servers that are always online, so friends can join your world even when you're not playing. You can also play with friends for free on the same Wi-Fi network or by joining each other's worlds through Xbox friends.
